title: DataIntegrityProof
description: Formal spec REQ-5-10/REQ-5-11. One W3C Data Integrity proof (https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-integrity/), ecdsa-jcs-2019 cryptosuite (REQ-5-12). Every operation carries one or more of these in its own `proof` array, sorted by `verificationMethod` in code-point order (REQ-5-10) -- a proof set, each checked independently against the operation's own unsecured content. `verificationMethod` is always `did:key:<key>#<key>` (REQ-5-14: the signer of a proof is the key named in this field).

proofValue.description: Multibase base58btc ('z'-prefixed) encoding of the raw, low-S signature bytes (REQ-5-13).
